result.topic_en: Corollaries on numbers of the form p^λ − q^λ divisible by a prime λn+1, on when −1 is a power residue, and a scholium on fifth powers modulo primes 5n+1 leading to the form ff − 5gg being divisible by such primes.
result.transcription:
134 RESIDVA EX DIVIS. POTESTATVM
Coroll. 2.
94. Semper ergo plures huiusmodi numero-
rum formae $p^{\lambda} - q^{\lambda}$ exhiberi possunt per numerum
primum $\lambda n + 1$ diuisibiles, ita vt factor $p - q$
non sit diuisibilis; atque adeo alterum numerorum
$p$ et $q$ pro lubitu[?] accipere licet.
Coroll. 3.
95. Si $n$ sit numerus par, in progressione
geometrica $1$, $a^{\lambda}$, $a^{2\lambda}$ etc. occurret terminus $a^{\frac{1}{2}n\lambda}$,
cui residuum $-1$ respondet; quare si diuisor pri-
mus sit $2m\lambda + 1$ in residuis reperietur $-1$, sin
autem sit $(2m+1)\lambda + 1$ tum $-1$ erit non-residuum:
euidens autem est si $\lambda$ sit numerus impar, posterio-
rem formam locum habere non posse.
Scholion 1.
96. Si omnes numerorum potestates quaesitae[?]
$1, 2^5, 3^5, 4^5$ etc. per numeros primos formae $5n+1$
qui sunt: $11, 31, 41, 61, 71$ etc. diuidantur, tan-
tum $n$ residua diuersa resultabunt, inter quae vti-
que reperietur $-1$. Huiusmodi ergo numerorum
formae $p^5 \pm q^5$ dabuntur per numerum primum
$5n+1$ diuisibiles, ita factor $p \pm q$ diuisionem
non admittat. Hinc alter factor qui est $p^4 \mp p^3 q$
$+ p^2 q^2 \mp p q^3 + q^4$ per eundem erit diuisibilis,
qui cum sit $(pp \mp \frac{1}{2}pq + qq)^2 - 5(\frac{1}{2}pq)^2$, dabitur
huiusmodi forma $ff - 5gg$ per $5n+1$ diuisibilis;
vnde sequitur si quadrata diuidantur per numerum
primum formae $5n+1$, tum inter residua certe
repe-

items.quote: Semper ergo plures huiusmodi numerorum formae $p^{\lambda} - q^{\lambda}$ exhiberi possunt per numerum primum $\lambda n + 1$ diuisibiles, ita vt factor $p - q$ non sit diuisibilis
items.english: Therefore several numbers of the form p^λ − q^λ can always be exhibited that are divisible by the prime λn+1, such that the factor p − q is not divisible by it.

items.quote: quare si diuisor primus sit $2m\lambda + 1$ in residuis reperietur $-1$, sin autem sit $(2m+1)\lambda + 1$ tum $-1$ erit non-residuum
items.english: Hence if the prime divisor is 2mλ+1, −1 will be found among the residues, but if it is (2m+1)λ+1, then −1 will be a non-residue.

items.quote: euidens autem est si $\lambda$ sit numerus impar, posteriorem formam locum habere non posse.
items.english: It is evident, moreover, that if λ is odd, the latter form cannot occur.
There will be a form ff − 5gg divisible by 5n+1.
